text: I came here after seeing reviews on Facebook. I wanted to reduce my jawline because I tend to chew on only one side, making my jaw uneven. So I consulted with the doctor at this clinic. The doctor gave excellent advice, recommending everything and explaining what injections were needed and where to correct the issues. I had jaw Botox done, and it's been two weeks now. I'll post pictures later. My jaw is instantly smaller, slimmer, and more V-shaped. I highly recommend P'Picha Clinic to everyone!
